Code

// Retry with jitter, bounded.
export async function retry<T>(run: () => Promise<T>, attempts = 3): Promise<T> {
  for (let i = 1; i <= attempts; i += 1) {
    try { return await run(); } catch (error) { if (i === attempts) throw error; }
    await sleep(2 ** i * 100 + Math.random() * 50);
  }
  throw new Error("unreachable");
}
